At the end of each game, a key phrase was obtained that had to be sent; whoever collected all of them entered the raffle for a computer and other little things.

456747.overview: Tonko is a Korean-made platform game that consists of very small (almost single-screen) stages. Each stage is a platform structure populated by monsters. The player controls a cute yellow goblin who must defeat these monsters, traveling through stages with real-world geographical backgrounds. Among the enemies are Nazi ghosts, vampires, beer mugs, American football helmets, crazy fish, and other unorthodox creatures. Tonko can jump and whack enemies on the head with his hammer, which can be upgraded with various power-ups (such as electricity charge) scattered around the stages. If an enemy touches Tonko, he loses a life; the game is over when Tonko has no lives left.

456858.overview:
Toi Acid Game begins while the protagonist, the Toi, is having a date in a discotheque with his girlfriend, Zoi. And then, there appears the usual crazy scientist, in this case called Dr Acid, who kidnaps the hero's girlfriend with the intention to provide diversion to his diabolic creations. The small and roundish friend cannot allow this, so he goes quickly to her rescue.

In order to accomplish it, he will have to face four different levels in which all kind of tiny beasts will try to cut his way. Thus, on the first stage, the disco, he will have to avoid some crude dudes, siphons, drinks which fall from above, etc., whereas he desperately looks for the eight plates that will allow the access to the next levels, which are: the beach, the pirate ship, and finally, the Acid House.

457636.overview:
Tremor for Quake is the follow-up to Head Games' Aftershock for Quake.

Unlike its predecessor which comes with a campaign consisting of three episodes, Tremor is merely a compilation of 500+ individual SP/DM maps (nearly a quarter of which are exclusive to this package) and 100+ QuakeC patches collected from the net, backed up by a basic front-end to launch the game with the selected add-ons.

Interestingly, both the new and the freely-available maps are decked in replacement textures, possibly to avoid a copyright infringement with id Software.

458151.overview: TOKENKAI was a commercial game made in "DIV language", by the company "Hammer Technologies", being an example (and sold as such) of the ability to make commercial Games of fresh out of the oven "DIV2 Games Studio". In fact, in "DIV2" came the source code of the Demo of the Game, so you could see how it was done, get ideas, or even try to improve it.

458238.overview:
"Tortugas Pijas (Posh Turtles) is a highly rare and obscure 2D side-scrolling action-platformer developed and published by Ediciones Manali. Capitalizing heavily on the global Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles pop-culture phenomenon of the early 1990s, this legally dubious Spanish bootleg replaces the classic four ninja brothers with an attitude-infused trio of mutated, anthropomorphic trend-chasing 'posh' turtles.

Instead of traditional martial arts gear and colored masks, the characters are designed with distinctly human 1990s fashion stereotypes: one radical turtle skates on a skateboard while sporting a backward baseball cap, another rocks a cool pair of dark sunglasses, and the third boasts a massive, pompadour-style Elvis Presley haircut. Players guide these bizarre reptilian heroes across linear urban sewer and street level platforms, jumping over hazards and bashing generic street thugs.

The game's engine was heavily compressed to fit on budget magazine coverdisks, displaying its character sprites and backdrops in a high-contrast 4-color CGA layout (using neon green, bright yellow, red, and black) accompanied by basic internal PC-speaker bleeps."

458310.overview:
"Troter Car is a rare, obscure 2D behind-the-car arcade racing game developed and published by Ediciones Manali. Moving away from standard top-down racers, the game tasks players with navigating a multi-car grid through competitive road courses viewed from a rear-chase camera perspective. Players choose from or race against four distinct vehicle tiers, including a sleek racing sports car with dual stripes, a compact street hatchback, a standard sedan, and a high-clearance 4x4 monster truck.

The core gameplay loop centers on dodging rival vehicles, managing tight cornering, and passing checkpoints within strict time limits to top the local high-score leaderboards. True to Ediciones Manali's budget shareware pipeline, the entire game engine was optimized to fit under a 100KB file format for magazine coverdisks, rendering its high-speed action in a restricted 4-color CGA layout composed of neon magenta, cyan, black, and white."

458317.overview: A racing game on a circuit, where players 1 and 2 will face each other.

458319.overview:
"Transmuter 2 (also known as TR2) is a rare 2D side-scrolling action platformer developed and published by Ediciones Manali. Released during the massive global hype of the 1991 cinematic blockbuster Terminator 2: Judgment Day, this bold, unauthorized bootleg transforms the iconic T-800 cyborg into a generic futuristic 'transmuter' enforcement unit tasked with blasting through dystopian industrial zones.

Players control a brawny, leather-jacket-wearing cybernetic operative navigating linear concrete platforms, using a rapid-fire laser rifle to vaporize waves of security droids and rival gang punks. True to the developer's budget roots, players must collect power-up ammunition blocks and complete stages under tight timer windows.

The game's loading screen famously features a pixelated recreation of the movie's signature poster art, compressed tightly into a high-contrast 4-color layout of neon purple, magenta, black, and white. This text-heavy action game was distributed primarily through budget Spanish computer magazine coverdisks, utilizing primitive PC-speaker sound effect loops."

458457.overview:
It's a freeware game for two players only, so it's not suitable for single players.

The game is very fun, and we can say it's not very ambitious, but if you have someone to play with, it will be a very enjoyable time.

458701.overview:
A star has rent the night sky and fallen to earth. Soon after, solitary irrintzis echo among the mountains, like a warning that no one can fully understand.

Since then, something has been unleashed.

Ravenous shadows roam the valleys and peaks. They are not simply enemies with steel. Alongside them, hostile men also advance, coming from other lands or born of violence.

Your mission is to survive. To resist. To discover what lies behind this invasion of darkness and blood. Every step will be a test. Every encounter, a decision.

Will you dare to continue walking when everything seems to be breaking?

Prepare yourself. May Amalur and Ilargi protect you from the coming night.

459546.overview:
TNT 2: Devilution is a 32-level megawad for Doom II. It is a vanilla-compatible, unofficial sequel to Team TNT's TNT: Evilution.

The WAD was infamous for its long and troubled development cycle, to the point that it became a running joke in the community. This reputation continued even after MAP26 from the WAD won the Mordeth award, with it being the only map remaining unfinished.

The development issues spawned projects like TNT: Revilution, Interception, and the upcoming TNT: Forever, which were all made from either rejected maps from Devilution or people leaving the project and making spinoffs, or both.

The first public beta was finally released on March 29, 2022, with the sixth beta version, the last before the full release, following on May 11, 2023.

TNT 2: Devilution was named one of the winners at the 2023 Cacowards.

459924.overview:
Hands down one of the most fun and versatile off-road simulation games ever made, Terep 2 is a wonderful freeware racing game created by Dénes Nagymáthé that is amazing on both gameplay and technical levels. Also known as Deformers, the game was developed by Invictus, a small Hungarian team who later developed the improved commercial sequel called Insane, published by Codemasters in Europe only.

Terep allows you to drive great-looking, realistic 3D cars on various surfaces. Similar to Stunts, you can drive anywhere you want - on the tracks, off the tracks, into the fields and beyond. Absolute freedom, in other words. The 3D physics engine is very well-coded - even the cars get deformed as you bump into roadblocks. In many ways, Terep 2 is a "work in progress" version of Insane, but the high production value will keep you occupied longer than many commercial games. In addition to the tracks included, you can create your own tracks using paint programs such as Paintshop Pro. The "mega" version (the one for download here) includes over 30 tracks made by the designers and fans. The game looks great, and plays great especially in two-player splitscreen mode. If you are a fan of off-road racing, it doesn't get much better than this little-known freeware old game. A must-have for racing fans!

460161.overview:
TerraAustralis-Mechanik is a Mechanik EN57 modification created by Robert Shaw, set against the vast landscapes of the Australian outback. The route places players in command of a Trans-Australian NR Class locomotive, one of the iconic freight and passenger engines that traverse the continent’s long-distance rail corridors.

The mod emphasizes the sense of scale and isolation unique to Australia’s interior, with expansive desert scenery, long stretches of track, and the operational challenges of running heavy trains across remote terrain. Adapted physics and custom assets help capture the feel of the NR Class in service.

Celebrated as one of the most distinctive international adaptations for Mechanik, TerraAustralis-Mechanik offers players a chance to experience the rugged atmosphere of Australian railroading within the classic simulator.

462869.overview: Terror en el Instituto takes place in a high school (which bears a striking resemblance to the one the author attended while developing the game) that has, in a sense, been "possessed." The game's objective is to discover why a peaceful school has transformed into a disturbing place filled with corpses, strange phenomena, and gory details before the protagonist succumbs to the supernatural exhaustion that has been building since entering the school. Of course, being overly curious can bring your search to an abrupt end...

462996.overview: Buster and the Beanstalk is a retelling of the Jack and the Beanstalk story starring Tiny Toon Adventures characters. The object of the game is to help two stars from the show, Buster Bunny and Plucky Duck, get into the Giant's castle

465644.overview:
Temple of Apshai is the first in Automated Simulations' Dunjonquest series of role-playing games series and one of the first computer role-playing games.

The game could be described as a graphical "roguelike", but actually it resembles the mainframe classic DND more, as you cannot see the whole level, but only your surroundings. Furthermore, the level maps are not randomized like in Rogue. Still, the gameplay has a lot in common with Rogue and other early dungeon crawls: A solo character explores a monster-infested, multi-level dungeon to grab some treasure, everything in top-down view.

465857.overview: It is the year 2400. Humankind has terraformed and colonized Mars. Over 1 million people live on Mars, when the contact to earth is cut off. A civil war starts, between the States of Mars, for the resources and the territories. At the height of the war, a comet is discovered en-route to Mars. A catastrophe is imminent. The citizens of Terra Inc., a huge industrial hive-city, build a railway network to move their city to the Southern hemisphere of the planet to escape the meteor. Too bad that the states on the Southern hemisphere will do everything in their power to fight You, and your city. Your mission is to fight the Southern states, and get to safety.

465858.overview:
A unique multi-genre game combining elements of puzzle and strategy.

The year is 2017 - the Earth has been contacted by an advanced alien race called Ubbermenscha, who proposed to get humans into the governing body of Galactic Sector Council. But when an envoy from Earth (the player character) has been elected by the UN and enters the alien ship - it turns out we are actually being abducted: the Ubbermenscha demands that we identify the very bad guy among the other Council members called the Usurper in order for humanity to be admitted to the council.

The player has to travel and investigate eight star systems with several planets orbiting around each star, finding different aliens and talking to them, mining different types of crystal that have to be exchanged for the valuable information - and discovering the true nature of each Council member - their friends and enemies, their preference in crystals, as well as their level of honesty, friendliness and loyalty to the Ubbermenscha - before identifying the Usurper and destroying his planet as instructed.

465859.overview:
Tetris Gold Professional is a basic protected-mode DOS Tetris game from 1998, distributed with DOS and Windows installers as was typical for Windows 3.1-era DOS games. There are no options and no difficulty selection. Level 2 chooses from more than one background image, music track, and a set of pre-filled blocks when you reach it.

In addition to the "selections from MOD Archive" music that the game itself uses (MOD files with ".TPM" file extensions), the disc contains a full album of techno mixes in Redbook Audio (CD Audio) format.

465866.overview:
This collection includes Thomas the Tank Engine & Friends & Thomas the Tank Engine 2: Thomas's Big Race.

In the first game you control Thomas the Tank Engine as he's got to take special trips he has to organise: Take children to the seaside, medicine to the hospital or deliver the mail. Beware of dead ends, level crossings, other trains and vehicles through your route! Based on the famous television and railway series, this game is designed for ages 3 and up. There is also a memory match game included with Part 1.

The second game focus's on races between Thomas and his friends. There is an option to play either alone and race against the CPU, or to race against a friend.

Players can choose to play as either Thomas, Gordon, James, Percy, Toby, Bill, Ben or Bertie. There are four courses: Main Line, Postal Run, Waterway, or Wood Glade.

465867.overview:
Britt Alcroft's train-based characters (famously voiced by Ringo Starr) were brought to several computer games, and this is perhaps the most unusual, simplifying the game of pinball to aim it at younger players. Four different tables are included, based loosely around Thomas, James, Percy and Toby. Up to 8 players can take it in turns, and there are 3 skill levels and a high score table.

The tables vary in their complexity and difficulty; Thomas' is very basic in its design, while the others (especially Toby's) have more advanced ramps and combos. Full screen and scrolling view modes are available, and the game's feel is comparable to the Pinball Dreams series, which is unsurprising as Spidersoft did Pinball Mania themselves.

465868.overview: Total Knockout: Championship Female Boxing! is a boxing game featuring an international all-female cast, presented as high-resolution pre-rendered sprites. The player's character is viewed from behind, with only a transparent green outline visible, similar to Toughman Contest or Super Punch-Out!!. Each match comprises two or three two-minute rounds, and is won by either knocking out the opponent or having more stamina left when the time runs out. In addition to left and right punches and blocks, every of the ten available fighters has her own special moves. Matches can be played against AI opponents with adjustable difficulty levels, or with other users over network.

465869.overview:
The dark lord Galuf has ambitions to take over the world, and there's only one thing left that he needs: three magic seals, said to be the most powerful weapons in existence. When he comes to the castle where they are hidden, the princess entrusts them to a fairy to find help. She escapes the castle and finds three young travelers of improbable hair colors: Rare, Medium, and Well. The fairy entrusts each girl with one of the seals, and they set off to defeat Galuf, rescue the princess, and restore peace to the kingdom.

Totsugeki! Mix is a cute action platform game. Choosing one of the three girls, each with their own unique weapon, the player must travel through ten different stages fighting Galuf's unreasonably cute army. There are several different special magic powers that can be collected, including a fairy familiar, magic shield, and time slow, and a boss waits at the end of each stage.

465870.overview:
In this out-of-canon adventure of gamebook hero Kai Master Lone Wolf, the player controls the dashing adventurer scaling the interior of warlock Gorazh's sinister magic tower Kazan-Gor -- an inverted pyramid, broadening as it gets higher -- in pursuit of a Lorestone of Nyxator located at the very top. Imprisoned in his flick-screen tower, Gorazh has filled it with monsters and traps, the most insidious of which was a magic mirror, Dhazag-Oud, whose seven shards reflect back superior counterparts of whoever gazes upon them (and which subsequently result in boss battles.)

This is a CD-ROM re-release of Lone Wolf: The Mirror of Death. However it appears the license of Lone Wolf was lost and the game was rebranded as Tower of Fear.

465871.overview: Trucks is a sci-fi vehicular action game set on the bustling planet Couroucoucou. As a major hub for intergalactic trade, Couroucoucou is home to numerous trading posts operated by powerful import-export companies. The planet's surface is a battleground for these corporations, with high rewards offered for completing missions that aid their expansion. Beyond the protective walls of these trading posts, indigenous populations dominate the open spaces. Drawn by the promise of luxury, adventurers from various races traverse the planet, seeking contracts with the trading companies. The player steps into the role of an independent truck driver, recruited from Earth by the influential Comptoir des planètes freight company.

465872.overview:
Thunder in Paradise is an interactive movie starring R.J. (Terry "Hulk" Hogan), Spence ("Hurricane" Spencer) and Martin "Bru" Brubaker (Chris Lemmon), among others. Based on the TV series with the same title, Thunder in Paradise refers to the main 'appendix' of the story: a supersonic boat called "Thunder". The game allows you to play through a Thunder in Paradise episode, titled "The M.A.J.O.R. and the Minor".

The game consists of several so-called 'game encounters': In "Thunder Encounter*", you control Thunder's powerful weapons to destroy as many threats to the boat as you can. This section of the game is somewhat like the arcade shooter "Paratrooper".

"Island Encounter" is very similar to other games like Mad Dog McCree, in which you should shoot the baddies, before they shoot you.

"Lab Encounter" has the same feeling as "Island Encounter", but set in the laboratory. Nice thing about this bit is, the way it's played (from a 'good' or 'bad' point of view) depends on how you did in the previous encounter.

465873.overview: Time Runners is a series of games about an alien race called the Skunks who are trying to conquer the universe, and a man named Max who's trying to stop them. The gameplay is primarily platforming action, with some point-and-click adventure elements.

465874.overview: The premise behind Time Treks is that someone has invented a time machine which has allowed so-called "time tyrants" to escape into the past and wreak havoc. You need to stop these time tyrants using your knowledge of history (and the information contained within the program) to solve various challenges. Some of these are point and click style mini-games, while others are tests of knowledge, trivia style.

465875.overview:
The 1996 Edition is a retail update of Tony La Russa Baseball 3 that includes the following new features.

improved response time in the user interface
stats for the 1995 season and updated rosters as of March 1st, 1996
improved stats, including batter vs. pitcher head-to-head comparisons
play-by-play announcements now include the batter names

465942.overview: This Jump'n'run action game was released in 1994 as a promotional game for advertising Kellogg's. Tony's friends were captured by ants and reptiles and so the tiger has to find and free them. Chocos the bear will support him with hints and explanations of the gameplay. Kellogg's nutrition can be found all over the level and will give you bonus life. There are also six vitamins hidden in each level. If you collect them all, you will get a bonus. There are some doors that can be opened by a red, green or blue key and will give access to other areas and bonus areas. There lifts, hidden platforms and imploding rocks to jump on. Ants will throw stones at you, so be careful. You can play as Tony or later as one of his friends Frog Smacks, Ape Coco or Toucan Sam. Each character has a special ability (Smacks can dive, Coco can climb and Sam can fly) that will help to master the level.

466626.overview:
As the world moved steadily toward a new Cold War, an event that would give birth to a bleak future occurred in 2004. In Quirinus, on the continent of Tartarus, a new metallic material known as Calcom was discovered.

With the discovery of this new metal, the global Cold War escalated into a new world war. Massive explosions caused by the simultaneous use of nuclear weapons by multiple nations sealed the space-time tunnels connecting to Tartarus. As a result, the national expedition forces stationed across the continent of Tartarus entered into a peace treaty and united under the name Union of Peace (UP).

During the early stages of these expeditions, Charisma had secretly infiltrated the remote Tairan Archipelago within Tartarus. Harboring a misguided dream of world domination, they focused on strengthening their military power. Once their existence was revealed, Charisma declared war on the UP government.

In-han Kang… he embarks on a daring adventure, joining Operation “Last Hope,” destined to become the UP’s final hope…

467394.overview: The plot is extremely conventional, which is quite explainable by the features of the subgenre, but at the same time it is exotic. In January 1776, the Spanish government sent a scientific expedition to Cape Horn (the southernmost part of South America) in order to study the geography and nature of the islands there, but as a result of a storm, the ship was wrecked - and its entire crew died, with the exception of the biologist Sebastian de Anchoren, who regained consciousness on the shore of an unknown island. However, it is quite possible that he was much less fortunate than the dead, for he ended up on the legendary "Unknown Land" in seafaring circles - a small island inhabited by various demons. And now his task is extremely banal - just to get out of there. It should be noted right away that the backstory is an absolute fiction of the author of the game, even in the sense that the images of local monsters have nothing to do with the folklore of the extinct Hellenous Indians of the Selknam (she), but rather copied from American low-budget horror films of the second half of the XX century.

467399.overview:
TIE Invaders is a simple, fixed-screen space shooter. The player takes control of a dinky, mobile cannon that can move left and right across the bottom of the screen. This unlikely defender finds itself harassed by a never-ending wave of alien intruders hell-bent on ruining everybody's day; these TIE fighters from space come in two main variants: smaller ones drop simple missiles straight down at the player, while their larger brothers prefer to fire three-way spread shots. There are no levels, just continuous action - more invaders arrive regularly to replace their fallen comrades.

The player's gunner can fire continuously, and its weapon can be gradually improved by collecting power-ups. There are three lives to start with, plus a new one for every 1000 points. The game runs entirely in (80x50) text mode, although in demoscene tradition it's tweaked for special effects like screen fades and scrolling starfields.

469130.overview:
We are pleased to present to your attention a real rarity from the era of childhood of Russian game development. A game developed by Alexander Efremov himself and published by the Doka company.

In 1992, Alexander Efremov developed a very unusual puzzle Hieroglyph, which is an extremely original variety of well-known tag. TimeWalk, released two years later, is a complete semblance of Hieroglyph in terms of gameplay, but with a completely different entourage, as well as the presence of additional extra-story modes.

The rules are as follows: a field of 3x3 cells is given (from the fourth level 4x4, from the fifth - 5x5), one of which is empty, and the rest contain elements of the labyrinth. On the four sides of the field there are groups of different people (depending on the level). In one of the cells of the labyrinth, a little man appears, who must be brought to the same people as he is (that is, so that his path ends on the corresponding side of the field), moving the cells like tag.

When there is only one person on the field, there is nothing difficult, but when there are two or more of them, the game becomes extremely difficult, because it is necessary to pave the way for everyone in conditions of a strict restriction on the movement of tiles. If a person gets into a dead end or goes to the wrong side of the labyrinth, he moves to the top of the screen; When all five are there, the game is over.

In total, TimeWalk has five levels, each of which takes place in one of the eras, as evidenced by the little men who need to be led through the labyrinth, and the background on which everything takes place. So, the first level is the era of cavemen, who, by the way, can turn into animals while passing through the playing field. The second level will send us to an ancient oriental city. On the third stage, it is proposed to move, as follows from the description, to Europe of the XIII century, although the background is the famous Neuschwanstein Castle, which was built not in the Middle Ages, but in the second half of the XIX century (attributing this castle to the Middle Ages is a very common mistake). The fourth level is a modern metropolis with skyscrapers, and the fifth is the future, represented by a volcanic eruption, robots and aliens.

As in Hieroglyph, there are three levels of difficulty, which differ in the speed of movement of the little men through the maze.

Separately, it is worth mentioning the User Mode. In it, we can decide for ourselves how to play – it is allowed to choose four types of people (even if all are from different eras), the size of the field, the music that will be played, and the speed of movement. There is also a background selection field, but it doesn't seem to work, since there is nothing to choose from, and the game always takes place just on a black background. Nevertheless, it is much more convenient to play without a drawing, because small people are better visible.

470719.overview:
An extremely little-known game, the latest creation of the Spanish company Goldy Games, released not in Spanish, but in English.

Turbo Flashy Cars is basically two games in one. The first is a puzzle in which you need to assemble an image of a hand-drawn car on some interesting background from virtual "pieces". The second is a cartoon race with a top view, where you drive a funny "retro" car and have to go through a relatively difficult track in conditions of limited fuel and the need to avoid a number of "deadly" obstacles for our car (such as pits) or not fatal, but no less dangerous (for example, there are several types of dangers at once that can change the direction of the car by 180 degrees, which is fraught with big problems). In this mode, the game is not very difficult, but it cannot be called simple either.

All this is presented in not really beautiful, but bright and quite sufficient for such a game EGA palette. In general, nothing special, but the combination of a race and a puzzle in one game is still an interesting solution.

474328.overview: Time Hunters is at its core a simple shooting gallery game, where you gun down dinosaurs for points. Why? Not sure, there is some story presented at the beginning of the game but it really doesn't matter. You need to kill a certain number of dinos before the timer runs out. It doesn't seem like any of the dinosaurs will actually attack you, so you don't need to worry about that. Graphics and sounds are decent enough, but it doesn't seem like there is a lot of variety. The mouse accuracy seems to be (almost?) pixel-perfect, so if you happen to hit a single pixel of a tree that's in front of your target, it won't register as a hit, which is rather annoying.

474346.overview: Time Hunter Pinball is a pinball simulator with only one table, a preshistoric jungle theme. The table layout is quite strange, since it is divided in two parts, left and right. You start playing in the left part on the screen, and you aim to reach the right part. The view is top-down, but it's non-scrolling. Like any pinball, there are targets, ramps, blocks, and so on. The game features a highscore table and the sound can be toggled on/off from the main menu.

482719.overview: Small racing cars compete on urban tracks filled with obstacles. Beat the opponent's time, avoid crashes and stay close enough to prevent time penalties. Two players can race on the same computer, and a track editor allows them to create their own courses.

482731.overview: Protect the Temelín nuclear power plant by shooting saboteurs before they enter. Distinguish attackers from civilians and technicians: shooting innocent people reduces the time available to complete the mission, while safely admitting technicians can restore it. Later missions demand faster and more careful target selection.

482738.overview: Rotate and place falling shapes to complete horizontal rows and leave room for new pieces. Miroslav Němeček's Czech Tetris-style game includes adjustable speed, an optional next-piece preview and a high-score table.
